title: How to Work With General Journals in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Journal entry methods without balancing accounts

features.name: General journals
features.description: General purpose journals used for almost all bookkeeping tasks in Business Central, accessible from the business manager role center and accountant role center under finance or journals.

features.name: Journal templates
features.description: Templates allow users to set up parameters that control the different journal types, enabling multiple journals for a given type to split tasks by type or between users.

features.name: Journal entry without balancing accounts
features.description: A method of filling in journals line by line where for each line, users specify the expense by selecting the account number and typing what the expense is, providing a clear overview of entries.
caveats: Better for users new to the system or simpler tasks

features.name: Journal entry with balancing accounts
features.description: A method where for each expense, users type in expense detail such as tax info and amount, then balance out the journal line by line by specifying the balancing account, reducing the number of lines needed.

features.name: General journal test action
features.description: An action that generates a test report to review journal entries before posting, allowing users to verify their work before committing entries.

features.name: Reverse register action
features.description: An action to reverse journal entries found through GL registers, which reverses entries completely and allows posting a new correct journal entry.

quotes.text: You can use journals to perform most of your bookkeeping tasks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes journals as a core tool for bookkeeping in Business Central

quotes.text: The general journals are general purpose journals used for almost all bookkeeping tasks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the scope and purpose of general journals in the system

quotes.text: All journal types have templates. Templates allow you to set up parameters that control the different journal types.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the template-based configuration approach for journals

quotes.text: There are two basic ways of filling in a journal with or without balancing accounts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces two distinct methodologies for journal entry that users can choose based on their needs

quotes.text: This way reduces the number of lines you must fill in, making journal entry faster.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the efficiency benefit of using balancing accounts approach

quotes.text: You can always check before you post the journal by using the general journal test action.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key safety feature for verification before committing entries

quotes.text: If you make a mistake, you can always reverse journal entries.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates flexibility in error correction for posted entries
